The author and practitioner

Executive experience. Published work. Proprietary thought.

Ricardo Manuel Machado Ferreira is a senior procurement and supply chain executive, independent author and Creator of the Ferreira Doctrine™ and Architect of Sovereign Decision Science™. His work brings procurement into the centre of decision quality, continuity, resilience, executive accountability and institutional defensibility.

His technical books form an integrated public corpus on how organisations admit, evidence, own and defend critical decisions before financial, operational, legal or reputational consequences become irreversible.

Serious decisions must become defensible before consequence appears.

Ricardo Manuel Machado Ferreira

Senior procurement and supply chain executive, multidisciplinary author, Creator of the Ferreira Doctrine™ and Architect of Sovereign Decision Science™.

Professional and authorial profile

Ricardo Manuel Machado Ferreira has more than three decades of experience across procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier governance, contracts, supply chain, planning, inventory, ERP, digital transformation, operational continuity and regulated business environments.

His experience spans industry, energy, health, infrastructure, hospitality, services, technology, public procurement and complex supply chains.

Core executive position

Procurement is not only a cost function. It is a control function for value, continuity, resilience, evidence and institutional accountability.

Sovereign Decision Science™

Decision integrity before commitment.

A proprietary discipline focused on how critical decisions are admitted, evidenced, owned, escalated, reconstructed and defended before consequence appears.

What the discipline examines

Admission

Whether a decision should enter a critical organisational system at all.

Evidence

Whether the decision is supported by sufficient, verifiable and reviewable proof.

Ownership

Whether responsibility is explicit, identifiable and recorded.

Application domains

Procurement & supply chain

Supplier dependency, contracts, continuity, value protection and critical-chain exposure.

Corporate and public governance

Executive accountability, institutional scrutiny and defensibility before boards, regulators or courts.

Technology and AI decisions

Human responsibility, evidence custody and governance where automation accelerates consequence.

The public layer explains concepts, language, the problem and strategic value. Protected architecture, formulas, criteria, thresholds, operating taxonomies, calibration, templates and implementation mechanics are not published.

Ferreira Doctrine™

The doctrine behind responsible, defensible decision systems.

The authorial and strategic body of thought that informs Sovereign Decision Science™.

Public principles

A decision without clear responsibility is structurally fragile.
Speed does not replace decision quality.
Automation does not eliminate human accountability.
Technical possibility does not guarantee institutional defensibility.
Risk must be governed before materialisation, not merely explained afterwards.
An organisation must be able to reconstruct the logic of its critical decisions.
Procurement protects value, continuity, resilience and decision integrity—not only price.

Doctrine and discipline

Ferreira Doctrine™ is the authorial doctrine concerning responsibility, risk, integrity, power and institutional sovereignty.

Sovereign Decision Science™ is the proprietary applied discipline that translates those principles into the analysis and governance of critical decisions.

A serious decision must become defensible before consequence appears.

The problems this work addresses

The store is organised around executive exposure patterns. The objective is not to sell documents by title; it is to guide the reader from a recognised risk to the correct public product, bundle, written review or licensing path.

Approved supplier

An approved supplier can still create exposure.

Read the Supplier Risk, Procurement or Supply Chain Shift briefings.

Signed contract

A signed contract can still leave the organisation unprotected.

Read the Contract Governance Shift or Contract Exposure Note.

Technology programme

A delivered system can still fail the governance test.

Read the Technology Transformation Shift.

Board pack

A board pack can exist without proving why a decision was defensible.

Read the Board Governance Shift or request a written review.

Public access

A purchased briefing is not implementation permission.

Read the Institutional Licensing Shift or enter the licensing path.

Critical decision

When consequence is real, a generic briefing is not enough.

Use the Premium Written Executive Review.

FAQ · Buying · Rights · Institutional access

Frequently asked questions.

Clear answers for readers, executives, procurement professionals and institutions before purchasing books, written products or requesting formal access.

What should I buy first?

If you are new to the work, start with The 72-Hour Decision Readiness Test. If you need a structured written record for executive reasoning, start with The Public Decision Record Pack.

What do I receive after purchase?

Digital written products are delivered through Payhip. Books are purchased through Amazon, where price, availability, delivery and fulfilment are managed by Amazon.

Are these products consultancy services?

No. Public written products are read-only materials. They provide a public-layer explanation of decision exposure, procurement risk, accountability and defensibility.

Can I use these products inside my organisation?

Purchase grants reading access only. Organisational implementation, deployment, training, derivative use, software use, AI/LLM ingestion or institutional use requires formal written authorisation.

Can I share a purchased product?

No redistribution is granted by purchase. You may share the public website or product purchase links. Sharing the purchased file itself requires written permission.

How do institutions request access?

Institutions should use the Institutional Access page or contact Ricardo Manuel Machado Ferreira directly for written evaluation, read-only institutional access or formal licensing discussion.

Rights notice: public access does not constitute implementation rights. Books and written products do not grant training, deployment, derivative, software, AI/LLM ingestion or organisational-use rights without formal written authorisation.
